faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Assistant position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is 28th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 3 Years Diploma in Chemical Engineering/Environmental Engineering/Mechanical Engineering/Energy Engineering/allied disciplines or a B.Sc/B.Sc (Hons.) in Chemistry/allied disciplines with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC and women candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 27,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the specified email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ANRF/ECRG/2024/000755/ENS.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad (IIT (ISM) Dhanbad).

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Assistant is on a contractual basis.
